details: Package name `@solana-labs/spl-toke` is a single-character deletion from the legitimate `@solana-labs/spl-token` package, indicating a likely typosquat against the Solana Labs scope. The shipped bundles (`lib/index.cjs.js`, `lib/index.esm.js`) contain co-occurring patterns of `require('child_process')`, `fetch(... POST...)`, and shell commands like `curl` and `ping` in the same files, which warrant manual code review to confirm whether they reflect benign tooling carried over from the legitimate package's bundle or active exfiltration / dropper behavior. Trace-level confirmation of the runtime behavior was not produced in this run, so a human reviewer should determine whether the network and child_process call sites are reachable from install/import or from a user-facing API, and whether destinations are attacker-controlled.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
